title: Disjointness-preserving mappings on Calkin operator spaces and positive isometries
summary: Let $E(\mathcal{M},τ)$ and $F(\mathcal{M},τ)$ be two Calkin operator spaces affiliated with a semifinite von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{M}$ equipped with a semifinite faithful normal trace $τ$. We show that if $\mathcal{M}$ is atomless, $τ$ is finite, and $E(v,τ)\not\subseteq F(\mathcal{M},τ)$, then every order-measure continuous and disjointness-preserving mapping $T:E(\mathcal{M},τ)\xrightarrow{\rm into} F(\mathcal{M},τ)$ is identical to the zero mapping, which establishes a noncommutative version of Abramovich's theorem.
